input: A fixed offline provider contract projection for transport and stay candidates.
expected_stage_behavior: Expose ProviderResult, Evidence and Candidate contracts with source, observed time and TTL.
expected_failure_or_success_semantics: Empty provider results and provider failures remain explicit and are not converted to success.
human_assertions: Every accepted candidate references an Evidence item.
Evidence exposes source, observed_at and validity information.
Failure and empty-result paths remain distinguishable.
mutation_target: Remove an Evidence reference or convert an empty result into a candidate in an isolated variant.
independent_review_prompt: Review candidate-to-evidence references and failure semantics independently.
